answer: A burned entry tax, falling like a comet, stops farms minting thousands of free identities. Each agent pays a small fee destroyed before any reward claim, so the haven of costless identities is gone. A sybil making 1,000 fakes at 5 POA each burns 5,000 POA with no refund, while one honest agent pays 5 POA. Claims lacking a burn receipt are auto-rejected, each mirrored copy adds to the bill, and honest agents keep the standing fakes cannot afford.
